title: The Signal of the Deep
author: Marguerite Winterbourne
blurb: Hazel Eriksen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
